entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The older brother, quiet and clever, who takes the Mightstone and builds artifact creatures and an artificer guild in Kroog.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: The rash, hot-headed younger brother who takes the Weakstone, controls dragon engines and leads the Fallaji.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: Mistress of the school and digsite who is killed in the brothers' explosion.

entities.name: Kayla
entities.description: Daughter of the king of Kroog, won by Urza and author of the original Antiquities War.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Icy-eyed woman who gives Mishra a powerful artifact and becomes his lover; she kills Urza's patron.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Young apprentice who shows Urza his ability to create artifact creatures.

entities.name: Taysir of Rabiah
entities.description: Planeswalker who composed the retelling presented by the comic.

entities.name: Yawgmoth Demon
entities.description: A demon of the Phyrexian realm who follows Mishra through the portal wanting his power.

entities.name: Mightstone
entities.description: Urza's powerstone, a half of a perfect whole.

entities.name: Weakstone
entities.description: Mishra's powerstone, which draws power from other objects.

entities.name: Caves of Koilos
entities.description: Caves stacked with Thran relics where the brothers find the powerstones.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: City where the king holds a contest for his daughter Kayla and where Urza builds an artificer guild.

entities.name: Suwwardi
entities.description: Fallaji tribe that enslaved Mishra and then accepted him.

entities.name: Fallaji
entities.description: Nomads of the Western Desert whom Mishra confederates under his control.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra told in the comic.

entities.name: Thran Empire
entities.description: The mysterious empire whose relics cover the landscape thousands of years after its fall.

events.summary: Two orphans from Argive, Urza and Mishra, are brought to Tocasia's school and spend years learning the secrets of the Thran.
events.quote: They live for many years at the school, learning the secrets of the Thran.

events.summary: The brothers fly Tocasia in the ornithopter, crash near the Caves of Koilos and find two powerstones; each craves both and they begin to mistrust each other.
events.quote: Urza takes the Mightstone , and Mishra the Weakstone .

events.summary: The brothers' contest ends in an explosion that kills Tocasia and many others, and they split ways.
events.quote: Their confrontation ends in an explosion, that kills Tocasia and many others.

events.summary: Urza wins the contest in Kroog with an artificial warrior to marry Kayla.
events.quote: Urza's constructs an artificial warrior that he uses to win the contest

events.summary: The Suwwardi enslave Mishra; he sees a Phyrexian realm in a vision, controls a dragon engine with the Weakstone and is accepted by the tribe, later confederating the Fallaji.
events.quote: Later he can confederate the several Fallaji tribes under his central control.

events.summary: Ashnod enters Mishra's camp, gives him an artifact and they kiss.
events.quote: Ashnod gives him a powerful artifact she has created herself and admits to being attracted to power.

events.summary: At the Korlis conference the king of Kroog attacks Mishra's forces with ornithopters; open conflict erupts; Ashnod kills Urza's patron, and Urza's Mightstone bests Mishra, who flees cursing Urza and his house.
events.quote: Fleeing, Mishra curses Urza and his house.

events.summary: Urza pursues the Fallaji with ornithopters into the Western Desert and is lured deeper into the sands.
events.quote: Urza's troops are lured even further into the unforgiving sandy landscape.

events.summary: Mishra and Ashnod use the Weakstone on the Thran Crystal at Koilos, opening a gateway to a hellish mechanical world, where the Yawgmoth Demon attacks and follows them back.
events.quote: When he uses the Weakstone on the Crystal, a gateway to the other world is opened.

events.summary: The Brothers' War spreads across Yotia and the Great Desert, and Mishra is changed by his experience in Phyrexia.
events.quote: Mishra's experience in Phyrexia seems to have changed him.

relations.note: Brothers, estranged after finding the stones.
relations.quote: Blonde Urza is the older brother, quiet and clever, while dark-haired Mishra is rash and hot-headed.

relations.note: Their conflict becomes the Brothers' War.
Head of the school the brothers attended.
relations.quote: One caravan also brings new students to the school of Mistress Tocasia

relations.note: Urza wins the contest for her hand and they have a child.
